about.headline: Brazilian Industry in Growth
paragraphs: ROCO is a manufacturer specialized in plumbing and hydraulic solutions, serving the market since 2014. With headquarters in Blumenau and Gaspar, Santa Catarina, we invest constantly in innovation and quality to better serve our customers.
Our operations span the entire national territory and exports to Paraguay and Bolivia. We combine industrial expertise with commitment to sustainability and best business practices.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a password you don't use on any other site.
resetPassword.hint: At least 8 characters. A long phrase is safer than a short password full of symbols.

approved.title: Your registration was approved!
approved.message: Your sales representative access is being enabled. If the menu hasn't changed yet, sign out and sign in again.

rejected.title: Your registration was not approved
rejected.message: If you'd like to understand why or send updated details, contact the ROCO team.

draft.title: Your registration isn't finished yet
draft.message: Fill in the missing details to send your registration to the ROCO team for review.

cnpjConflict.title: There's already a registration with this CNPJ
cnpjConflict.message: Your email is confirmed, but another registration with the same CNPJ is already under review or approved. Contact the ROCO team to sort it out.

none.title: Your access hasn't been enabled yet
none.message: Your account exists, but it doesn't have permission to use the portal yet. If you're expecting access, contact the ROCO team.

page.clearCartConfirm: Remove all products from your quote?

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email — ROCO Portal
verifyEmail.intro: We received your pre-registration on the ROCO Portal. Confirm your email to send it to our sales team for review.
verifyEmail.note: The link is valid for 24 hours and can only be used once.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you didn't register, please ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Password reset — ROCO Portal
resetPassword.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your ROCO Portal account.
resetPassword.note: The link is valid for 60 minutes and can only be used once.
resetPassword.ignore: If you didn't request a reset, please ignore this email: your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed — ROCO Portal
passwordChanged.intro: The password of your ROCO Portal account was just changed. For security, sessions open on other devices are signed out.
passwordChanged.note: If it wasn't you, reset your password now and let the ROCO team know.
passwordChanged.ignore: If it was you, there's nothing else to do.
